objective: Decide whether the generated-config validation track needs another scoped target set or should hand off to metadata-invariant review after the additional-target public pack closes.

decision.reason: The generated-config path now has enough correctness breadth for the current track: six tracked templates at 1x1, the same six templates at 32x1 and 1x32, and three additional tracked targets at 1x1 all pass coverage-output equivalence. Adding another target set would mainly increase evidence volume while leaving the sharper remaining risk unaddressed: whether template metadata invariants are explicit enough for Verilator-like usage without per-target hand-maintained assumptions.

candidate_review.name: tlul_template_schema_metadata_invariant_review
candidate_review.reason: It directly attacks the remaining usability risk for passing a filelist/template and getting a predictable GPU-backed simulation plan: clock/reset metadata, source files, overlays, coverage manifests, builder metadata, and compare policy must be consistently machine-checkable.

candidate_review.name: another_generated_config_target_set
candidate_review.reason: More targets would improve breadth, but the current three execution layers already cover NVDLA, ITA, paged-attention/KV, and OpenTitan primitive templates. The next weakest point is metadata consistency rather than another correctness run.

candidate_review.name: larger_shape_or_repeat_median_timing
candidate_review.reason: Timing and larger-shape evidence should remain separate from the generated-config correctness and metadata-invariant track.

candidate_review.name: resident_execution_optimization
candidate_review.reason: Runtime tuning should wait until the generated-config/template metadata surface is stable enough for routine operator use.

candidate_review.name: quantized_kv_cache_boundary
candidate_review.reason: Quantized KV-cache remains a new workload boundary and should not be mixed into this validation handoff.

required_next_gate.name: define_tlul_template_schema_metadata_invariant_review_gate
